hooks.command: f="$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty')"; case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*.py|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*.pyi) [ -x "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/bin/ruff" ] && "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/bin/ruff" format --force-exclude "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; true
